what: Video and photo tiles scattered over the board swell with their distance from the cursor. Within 20% of the screen width, the closer, the larger, up to 1.3 times, and the size chases 8% of the remaining difference each frame so it grows and shrinks smoothly (from the center). Touch devices use the screen center instead of the cursor and widen the radius to the full screen width. For tiles on boards you drag around, like maps and canvases.

options.reach: Swell radius — share of screen width, default .2
options.reach-touch: Interaction device radius — share of screen width, default 1

from.where: index.html .hd-item (20 video tiles over the map — original update: within screen width × (phone 1 · PC .2), 1 + closeness × .3, currentScale += (target − current) × .08 × deltaRatio, three panel meshes use the same ratio too)

note: The original computes only cells that are on screen or within a radius, and applies the same scale to the three version mesh — the part only changes the scale of the cell element
